__overrides.contains: スタンダードプランには初回3日間の無料お試し
__overrides.html: The Standard plan comes with a 3-day free trial for first-time subscribers. During the trial you can try each feature once; after 3 days it automatically continues at $9.99/month. Cancel within the free period and you will not be charged. Basic and Premium are billed from the time you subscribe (the details shown on the checkout screen take precedence).

__overrides.contains: はい。プランや残コインはアカウントに紐づくため
__overrides.html: Yes. Your plan and remaining coins are tied to your account, so signing in with the same account on any device — iPhone, Android or a desktop browser — brings everything with you. To be safe when switching phones or reinstalling, register an email address and password in the app under Settings → “Data transfer” so you can always sign in from anywhere.

__overrides.contains: はい、いつでも解約できます。ご購入経路によって
__overrides.html:
Yes, you can cancel anytime. Where you cancel depends on where you purchased.
・Purchased on the web (browser): use the “Manage subscription” link (billing portal) in the confirmation email you received at purchase.
・Purchased on Android (Google Play): cancel from “Subscriptions” in Google Play.
・From the app: Settings (⚙) → “How to use” → the “Cancel / manage subscription” button at the bottom.
Note that simply selecting the “Free” plan on the app’s plan screen does not cancel (auto-renewal continues). After canceling, paid features stay available until the end of the current billing period. Your account, analysis data and remaining coins are kept (you just return to the free plan limits). Questions? Contact info@gooner-info.co.jp.

__overrides.contains: ご購入・ログインは、操作したブラウザにログイン状態
__overrides.html:
Your purchase and sign-in are saved as a session in the browser you used. Opening a link from an email (Gmail, etc.) can launch a different app or browser (Chrome / Google) than the one you started in (e.g. Safari); that other browser has no session, so the purchase may look like it has not been applied. Rest assured: your purchase is always recorded on your account and never lost.

What to do:
・Reopen RELA in the browser you used first (e.g. Safari) — it will be applied there.
・To use a different browser or app, sign in to the same account there.
・Recommended: register an email address and password in the app under Settings → “Data transfer”. Then you can sign in to the same account on any browser or device without relying on magic links, and your purchases and coins are always applied.

If it still does not apply, contact info@gooner-info.co.jp.
